requirements.requirement: The system must parse sponsor data from the schema defined in ST-001 into an internal transformation object without loss of required fields.
The system must normalize funding source values into one of: public, private, or undisclosed.
The system must convert raw collaborator arrays into a display-ready comma-separated string.
The system must generate a human-readable score contribution string based on sponsor credibility score input.
The system must preserve sponsor name and type exactly as provided unless formatting is explicitly defined in the schema.
The system must return a fully populated display object ready for UI consumption without requiring additional transformation in MessageBubble.
The system must handle multiple collaborators and ensure ordering is preserved from the input data.
The system must default funding source to 'undisclosed' when the input value is missing or null.
The system must return an empty string for collaborators when no collaborators are provided.
The system must generate consistent output structure regardless of input variability to prevent UI rendering failures.
The system must use deterministic logic (non-random) when generating score contribution text for identical inputs.
The system must ensure score contribution text reflects the relative credibility level (e.g., high, medium, low) derived from input score.
The system must not expose raw backend field names in the display-ready output.
The system must gracefully handle malformed sponsor objects by returning a safe fallback display object without throwing runtime errors.
The system must ensure all output strings are trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace.
